name: sourcefold
description: Read, add and organize your Sourcefold research library from Claude.
long_description:
Lets Claude work with your Sourcefold library the way you do: list projects, groups and sources, read sources in parts, search inside them, add YouTube videos and playlists, articles, PDFs and more, move, rename and delete things, highlight passages, write notes and save to Google Drive.

If the Sourcefold desktop app is signed in on this computer, Claude uses its sign-in and nothing needs to be filled in. Otherwise create an access token on the Sourcefold website (Settings → Create token) and paste it below.

With the desktop app open, Claude can also search inside your sources, open things in the app for you, and save paid Substack posts you subscribe to.

api_token.title: Access token (optional)
api_token.description: Leave empty to use the Sourcefold desktop app's sign-in on this computer. Otherwise create one on the Sourcefold website: Settings → Create token.

web_url.title: Website address (optional)
web_url.description: Only needed with an access token, if your Sourcefold website isn't the default one.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Shows who Sourcefold is signed in as on this computer, whether the Sourcefold desktop app is open (and its mode), and the Google Drive state (connected, how many changes are not saved yet).

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Lists the user's projects (the top level of the library) with each one's id, number of groups and number of sources.

tools.name: get_project_tree
tools.description: Shows one project's groups as a tree (nested groups are indented), each with its id and number of sources.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Lists the sources in one group, one line each: `[id] kind · title · author · author type · saved date · status · tags` (and the error when saving failed), after the group's subgroups.

tools.name: find_sources
tools.description: Searches the library.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Everything about one source except its text: kind, title, url, group, author or channel and the other details saved with it, saved date, status (and the error), and the user's own note.

tools.name: read_source
tools.description: Reads one source (an article, transcript, web page, PDF, thread or note), including the user's highlights and note at the end.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Creates a new top-level project.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Creates a group inside a project or inside another group (groups nest to any depth).

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Renames a group or project, moves it into another project or group (parent_id; null makes it a top-level project, which only works for a group without sources), changes its position among its siblings, or archives/unarchives a project (archived; projects only).

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Deletes a group (or a whole project) together with every group inside it and every source in them.

tools.name: update_source
tools.description: Renames a source (title), moves it to another group (group_id), or sets, replaces or clears the user's own note on it (note; null clears it).

tools.name: move_sources
tools.description: Moves several sources into one group (a group, not a project).

tools.name: delete_sources
tools.description: Deletes sources by id.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Creates a standalone note (a source of kind Note with text you write, in Markdown) inside a group.

tools.name: edit_note
tools.description: Changes the title and/or replaces the whole text of a standalone note made with create_note (or in the app).

tools.name: list_highlights
tools.description: The user's highlights (passages they marked while reading, with their notes), for one source, one group, or a whole project.

tools.name: add_highlight
tools.description: Highlights a passage in a source, as if the user selected it in the reader; it shows in the reader, the Highlights tab and the source's file.

tools.name: update_highlight
tools.description: Sets or clears (note: null) the note on a highlight.

tools.name: delete_highlight
tools.description: Deletes one highlight (the passage stays in the source; only the mark and its note go).

tools.name: remove_text
tools.description: Cuts text the user doesn't want out of a saved source (an article, transcript, web page, PDF or thread), like the Remove text mode of the desktop reader: the source's file, its Drive copy and the reader all change.

tools.name: undo_remove_text
tools.description: Puts back the last text remove_text cut out of a source in this session, with the highlights that went with it.

tools.name: add_links
tools.description: Saves links into a group, like pasting them into Sourcefold's Add links.

tools.name: get_add_progress
tools.description: Progress of an add_links job: each link's state (waiting, saving, saved with its source id, already saved, not saved with the reason, paid, paused while YouTube limits requests, failed with the message).

tools.name: list_collection
tools.description: Lists the videos of a YouTube playlist or channel (newest first for channels) or the posts of a Substack publication (with date and paid/free), without saving anything.

tools.name: save_to_drive
tools.description: Saves the library's changes to the user's Google Drive now (the files and folders Sourcefold keeps there).

tools.name: add_image
tools.description: Adds a picture (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 10 MB) to a group as an image source.

tools.name: show_in_app
tools.description: Opens a group, a source or a highlight in the Sourcefold desktop app and brings its window to the front, so the user can look at it.

tools.name: set_source_info
tools.description: Updates research info on one or more sources (1–50): triage status (keep, maybe, cut, or 'none' to clear), add_tags, remove_tags, tags (explicit list), author, author_type (lab, researcher, journalist, company, government, creator, forum, encyclopedia, other), and summary (pass '' to clear).

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Lists the outline sections and other tags used across sources in a project, with the count of sources tagged with each.

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Finds duplicate sources in a project using findDuplicateSets: each set with reason, ids, titles, group paths, and saved dates.

tools.name: merge_duplicates
tools.description: Merges one or more duplicate sources into keep_id, re-attaching their highlights and cards, and deletes the duplicates.

tools.name: make_card
tools.description: Creates a quote card from an existing highlight_id OR from (source_id and quote).

tools.name: add_broll
tools.description: Adds a b-roll clip (video segment) to a project's research outline.

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: Lists the cards in a project outline (quotes, b-roll clips, lines) grouped by outline section and unplaced cards.

tools.name: edit_outline
tools.description: Performs one or more outline mutations in order: add_section, rename_section, delete_section, move_section, place_card, unplace_card, set_line, add_line, delete_card.

tools.name: get_script
tools.description: Exports the project's research outline as a narration script with citations, a reference list of cited sources, keep_references (all sources marked keep), or a chronological b-roll clip list.
